d.seg: हाँ तो अपना व्हाट्सएप नंबर बोलो व्हाट्सएप पर अभी से एक ही बार पहली बार में क्या
d.tr: So tell me your WhatsApp number, right now, the first time?
d.ctx: The user is asking the expert for their WhatsApp number. The expert responds by saying they will message the user on WhatsApp.
d.j: The user is explicitly asking for the expert's WhatsApp number, which is a strong case for moving contact outside the app.
